Read every Task comment before continuing: they settle the seat kinds. Final design: no Comparison; Matchup renamed Seating (two seats); a seat is the held checkpoint (Inference), a fixed player (Code or a chosen Model), or a relative seat: At(clock, value, job=None), Final(job=None), Earlier(clock, by, job=None), Fraction(clock, value, job=None), Aligned(clock, job). No Latest, no Fixed. Every relative seat resolves to the same checkpoint whenever held. Curve keeps only title, split, matches; HeadToHead goes.
